title: The Washington Post ownership and control
summary: The Washington Post is a United States newspaper and digital news publication based in Washington, D.C. Its publisher, WP Company LLC, is wholly owned by Nash Holdings LLC, which is owned by Jeff Bezos. The Post’s current official disclosure identifies Bezos as its owner; September 2026 reporting also documents his leadership appointment authority.
